summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of equity securities, a regular distribution declaration, and NAV disclosure. AB Private Lending Fund sold 10,382 Class I shares for $256,011 to feeder vehicles under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg S. It also declared a $0.20 per share distribution payable May 29, 2026 and reported NAV per share of $25.00. The fund continues a continuous public offering of up to $1.0B in shares. No M&A, restructuring, or special situation is present; this is a routine periodic disclosure of ongoing capital raising and dividend activity.
